note: The cheapest loud win (brief 013 D; brief 018 §5): the reference loud with the Scout and Fixer holding fire until the final fight, so the guard's are the only traced shots. Its orders up to the walk to the car are c017's hand-tuned ticks, pinned by `at`, without c017's close on the café wall (the Scout and Tech stay in their cover: walking Vale, the Enforcer no longer fires, so they must keep the blocker in their line, and it is down 3.3 s into the fight). Board and go: once the blocker is down the whole cell boards and the car leaves with the officers still at their stands. Re-sited 2026-10-19 (Waymark, brief 023; Sky's door option (b)): the reference loud now holds fire the same way (the response unit passes the getaway car on its way to the west-face door, and a drawn weapon there starts the fight early), so this run's head is the reference's, composed rather than pinned (the c017 ticks no longer reach the cabinet in time), and nobody is downed, so the Tech no longer carries the Fixer: the whole cell boards once the blocker is down. It plays as the reference loud does; the fastest and cheapest loud is now the reference itself (no earlier shot is possible: the reroute lands at 2:04, the guard's next mark is 2:30). Brief 027 (Waymark, 2026-10-21; engines 0.17.0 and 0.18.0, tuning.md §11-§13: police answer every operative who fired on them in the last 3 s, so they no longer flip between the cell's shooters): the three wait behind the getaway car instead of the car's east end and the pavilion piers (there the passing response unit downed the Scout at 2 m and the Fixer had no line past his pier), and fight with locks: as the doors open all three lock the nearest officer of the response unit, then, once it is down, the blocker. Focus is what wins it: the same waits firing at will leave an op behind or fail in 26 of 48 half-metre and metre moves of one wait (engine 0.18.0), with the locks in 11 of 48; the first locks must be given within 0.5 s of the doors opening, so pause (briefs/027/waymark/loud-robust-0.18.txt). Brief 027, engine 0.19.0 (Waymark, 2026-10-22; Pulse hostile-initiative.md, the rival crew drawn by the gunfire presses for the Vale holder): walking Vale straight to the car the Enforcer was downed by the crew from behind at 4:11.9. So the cell protects him: as the doors open he holds Vale at the service door, where the Office's west corner is between him and the crew (it stops at its stop point of him, 13 m off, with no line), while the three drop the response unit at the car as before; once it is down the Scout and the Fixer lock the crew and walk across the square to flank it at 10-11 m, inside its own reach, and drive it back (3 hits); then he walks Vale to the car, the Scout and the Fixer walk back to their waits, and the Tech holds the car from his wait, the west pier between him and the café wall officers (briefs/027/waymark/loud-robust-0.19.txt).
